'When this attacks, you MAY pay {r}{r}{r}. IF YOU DO, this gets +3{p}.'

The payment is the MAY's COST, so declining runs nothing and the +3 is reachable only by paying -- 'if you do' needs no separate plumbing. Authored as an effect the resources would be spent even when the player declined, and a controller who cannot pay would be charged anyway.
